title: Glass Shelf With Towel Bar 16-Inch Wall-Mounted Solid Brass | Satin Brass | Waverly Place | Allied Brass
description:
Clear counter clutter and add everyday storage with this wall-mounted glass shelf—also a bathroom shelf or wall shelf—with an integrated towel bar (towel rack/towel holder) for towels at the sink in Satin Brass, which combines warm golden tones with a brushed texture, bringing modern warmth without the high shine of polished brass. Designed for the Waverly Place collection, it coordinates easily with matching Waverly Place pieces and complements transitional bath accessories and transitional bathroom hardware.

Highlights:
- Satin Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Coordinates beautifully with other Waverly Place hardware in the same finish
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Save space with a wall mount / wall-mounted installation

Specs & Installation:
- Shelf dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
- Glass thickness: 3/8 inch (0.38 in)
- Projection from wall: 5 inches
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Mounting type: wall mount
- Included: glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size #8 x 1 1/4)
- Assembly required: no
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
